cases.name: root:topos-measure · held@3 · README.md
expected: The four origins that measured room do not meet: no value in celsius is held by all of their readings, and no average of them closes that.

cases.name: agreed:topos-measure · held@3 · README.md
expected: The three origins that measured room meet: every one of their readings holds 19.9..20.1 celsius.

cases.name: alone:topos-measure · held@3 · README.md
expected: Only one origin measured room: its reading holds nothing yet, until a second origin's reading meets it.

cases.name: crossed:topos-measure · held@3 · README.md
expected: The four origins that measured room do not meet: no value in celsius is held by all of their readings, and no average of them closes that.
